attribution.description: Who wrote a record on another service. The community writes every bridged record, and the AppView honours this attribution only on records the community itself wrote.

registration.description: Record key of the registration the record was written for.

platform.description: The service the author is on, as its bridge names it.

remoteId.description: The author's id on the other service. Opaque to Colibri.

name.description: The author's display name on the other service when the record was written.

avatar.description: The author's avatar, uploaded to the community's repo.

remoteMessage.description: The id of the message on the other service, which lets a bridge find its own records again.

imported.description: Set on messages a bridge imported from the room's earlier history. The AppView sends no notifications for them, and marks their live events as imported.

remoteAuthor.description: The person on the other service a bridge is writing for.

id.description: The author's id on the other service.

name.description: The author's display name on the other service.

avatar.description: An avatar uploaded earlier with uploadBlob.

link.description: A Colibri channel kept in sync with a room on another service.

remoteRoom.description: The id of the room on the other service.

remoteName.description: The room's name on the other service when the link was made.

backfill.description: The latest history import an admin asked for.
A request to import a linked room's earlier messages.

since.description: The oldest message to import. Absent imports the room's whole history.

requestedAt.description: When an admin asked for the import. Messages after this were relayed live.

backfillStatus.description: Progress of a history import, as the bridge last reported it.

requestedAt.description: The request this status belongs to.

imported.description: How many messages the bridge has imported so far.

from.description: The start of the time range being imported.

until.description: The end of the time range being imported.

reached.description: When the newest imported message in the channel was sent.

remoteRoom.description: A room a bridge can see on the other service, offered to admins when linking channels.

id.description: The room's id on the other service.

kind.description: What sort of room it is.

parent.description: Name of the group or category the room sits in, if any.

registrationView.description: A bridge registered with a community.

community.description: The community the registration belongs to.

bridgeHandle.description: The bridge's handle, when it resolves.

platform.description: The service the bridge connects to.

remoteSpace.description: The id of the server, workspace or network on the other service.

remoteSpaceName.description: Its name on the other service.

backfills.description: Progress of each linked channel's latest history import.

enabled.description: Whether the bridge may currently write.

mirrorModeration.description: Whether moderation crosses the bridge. When on, hiding a bridged message removes its original on the other service, and a moderator removing a relayed message there hides it here.

createdBy.description: The admin who paired the bridge.

pairingView.description: A pending pairing, shown to an admin before they confirm it.

bridge.description: The bridge that asked to pair.

bridgeHandle.description: The bridge's handle, when it resolves.

platform.description: The service the bridge connects to.

remoteSpace.description: The id of the server, workspace or network on the other service.

remoteSpaceName.description: Its name on the other service.

bridgedActor.description: Marks a profile view as someone on another service whose messages a bridge relays.

registration.description: Record key of the registration the record was written for.

platform.description: The service the person is on.

bridgedReactor.description: Someone on another service who reacted to a message through a bridge.

registration.description: Record key of the registration the reaction was written for.

platform.description: The service the person is on.

name.description: Their display name on that service when they reacted.
